description:
On the post-fix workflow run 25028609129 (commit bc3fd7c) tarpaulin reports `100.00% coverage, 1662/1662 lines covered`. Locally `make ci` on the same tree reports `100.00% coverage, 2031/2031 lines covered`. Both pass the `--fail-under 100` gate, but the runner is measuring ~18% fewer lines (369 lines short).

A 100% coverage floor that silently shrinks the denominator on CI is a gap, not a guarantee — uncovered code can land if it lives only in whatever the runner is excluding.

Likely suspects:
- `lernie-ui-egui` test binary not running (or compiling differently) on headless ubuntu-latest. The compile log shows it builds, but tarpaulin may exclude or skip its tests.
- `--exclude-files 'src/bin/*' --exclude-files 'crates/*/src/main.rs'` matching different paths under the runner workspace layout.
- Per-crate test binaries discovered differently because of cache state, target/ pruning, or feature flags.

Reproduce: compare per-binary line counts. Local: `cargo tarpaulin --workspace --skip-clean --engine llvm --out Json --output-dir /tmp/tarp-local --exclude-files 'src/bin/*' --exclude-files 'crates/*/src/main.rs'` then `jq '.files | to_entries | map({path: .key, lines: (.value.coverage | length)}) | sort_by(.lines) | reverse' /tmp/tarp-local/tarpaulin-report.json`. On the runner: drop a tarpaulin `--out Json` step and upload the report as an artifact, diff against local.

Fix direction: either (a) make CI measure exactly what local measures (install whatever system deps unblock the missing test binaries, e.g. wayland/X11 for egui), or (b) explicitly exclude the same files locally so the two denominators agree, with a comment in tarpaulin.toml explaining why. Prefer (a) — narrowing local coverage to match a degraded CI is the wrong direction.

Gates (per CLAUDE.md):
- tests: workflow run on the merge commit must be green AND local & runner line counts must match (or the discrepancy must be deliberate and documented in tarpaulin.toml)
- docs: if exclusions change, update tarpaulin.toml's leading comment block
- alignment: keep the 100% floor and the principle that the floor means the same thing on every machine
title: CI: investigate 369-line coverage denominator gap between local and runner
